title: DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY
text: If I could give this no stars I would. I ordered these, I wanted to try for a month, and I had thought to get more if that one worked out well. So I ordered it. I waited for the right amount of time, because they are a monthly subscription. When they didnt come, I asked why and they said that they couldnt deliver to my address. So I asked for my money back and it took a little while, but I finally got my money back for it.
label: negative
